metadata.description: Manual FOCUS workspaces require private PostgreSQL and background assessments.
Worker CPU; memory is paired safely: 1 CPU/2 GiB, 2 CPU/4 GiB, 4 CPU/8 GiB.
Optional image for database bootstrap before application release; otherwise reuse the API image.
Stage only the private database and manual bootstrap job; preserve existing application resources until bootstrap is verified.
Optional numeric worker/API safety budgets. Defaults are validated again by the runtime.
Published API image; leave both image parameters empty for foundation-only provisioning.
Published static web image; no public placeholder application is deployed.
Retired and ignored: manual FOCUS uploads never use a native-export storage ingress exception.

Policy-restricted subscriptions: put the container registry behind a private endpoint and deny public network access. Requires the Premium registry tier and stops azd remote builds from reaching the registry.
PostgreSQL deployments always require private ACR. Use a private Docker build host, or opt into a managed pool only in a supported region.
Optional operator-controlled private Docker VM with NAT egress. Adds VM/disk/NAT cost; no public VM IP or inbound access.
Policy-restricted subscriptions: enable blob versioning and blob/container soft delete on the export storage account.
Days to keep daily month-to-date FOCUS snapshots under cost-exports/focus-daily/.
Days to keep closed-month FOCUS exports under cost-exports/focus/. Must cover the longest 6-month history window.
Months each subscription may export at once. Keep 1 until Azure is confirmed to run one export's months in parallel.
Retired: manual FOCUS mode never deploys the native export scheduler.
Only set true when redeploying the same environment name after azd down without --purge left a soft-deleted AI Foundry account behind.
Reuse an already-created Foundry account and deploy only its project, model, RBAC and private endpoint children.
Worker cadence. Each tick advances monthly pulls and starts daily pulls once their UTC time has passed.
Keep false until the Foundry agent and model invocation are verified end to end.
Enable grounded chat through the app-local Model Router without enabling the separate hosted-agent narrator.
Subnet for the registry build agents. They run on virtual machine scale sets, so this subnet must carry no delegation and cannot be shared with the Container Apps subnet.
Put the registry behind a private endpoint and deny public network access. Requires the Premium tier, and azd remote builds can no longer reach the registry.
Build agent size. S1 is 2 CPU/3 GB, S2 is 4 CPU/8 GB, S3 is 8 CPU/16 GB.

Empty until specific models, versions, deployment SKUs and quota are approved.
Only set true when redeploying the same environment name after azd down without --purge left a soft-deleted account behind; a genuinely new environment has nothing to restore.
